bio.text: Christian Vukasovich is the Democratic nominee for Michigan's 5th Congressional District in 2026, after advancing from the August 4 primary.
According to the campaign website, Vukasovich earned bachelor's and master's degrees at Eastern Michigan University and a Ph.D. in media and communication from Bowling Green State University.
The campaign website says Vukasovich spent nearly two decades teaching at universities and has been a union organizer with the American Association of University Professors.
